item.title: The cold attack begins Wednesday and continues through the weekend
item.description: A cold wave is expected to hit on Wednesday, bringing gusty winds and temperatures in the 20s, followed by a brief warm-up before another cold wave arrives on Saturday, bringing the possibility of snow flurries.

item.title: Missouri man accused of selling nonexistent trailers on Facebook Marketplace
item.description: PURDY, Mo. — An Independence man is accused of scamming a Barry County resident out of $18,000 in an online sale involving five semi-trailers that were never delivered. item.title: Residents split as Springfield revives hotel tax vote for new convention center
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. — Springfield voters will again be asked to decide whether to raise the city hotel tax to help fund a new convention center, just months after a similar measure failed at the ballot box. City leaders say the project could create jobs and bring millions of dollars in tourism spending to the region. [...]

item.title: Missouri court upholds ban on minors' gender transitions
item.description: JEFFERSON CITY, Mo. — Today, the Missouri Supreme Court unanimously upheld the state’s SAFE Act, a law banning gender-transition procedures for minors and prohibiting the use of Medicaid funds for such treatments.
